scenes.narration: In 1206, one engineer described a machine you could program.
His name was Al-Jazari, chief engineer at the Artuqid court in Upper Mesopotamia.

scenes.label: The Book of Knowledge of Ingenious Mechanical Devices
scenes.narration: That year he finished The Book of Knowledge of Ingenious Mechanical Devices.

scenes.title: The programmable drum machine
scenes.narration: One was a band of musical automata. Pegs on a rotating drum set the beat. Move the pegs, change the rhythm.

scenes.title: Then → Now
scenes.narration: The crankshaft and camshaft he described still turn inside engines today.

linkedin.content:
In 1206, engineer Al-Jazari described a drum machine you could reprogram by moving pegs on a rotating cylinder.

The crankshaft and camshaft he described still turn inside engines today.

Which "modern" idea do you think is older than we assume?
